echoTasks.find: Large circumferential echo free space with a swinging heart and diastolic collapse of right atrium and right ventricle
Dilated inferior vena cava with minimal collapse on sniff
Exaggerated respiratory variation of mitral inflow with low forward output

auscultation.added: Pericardial rub still audible at the left sternal edge

exam.general: Acutely breathless man sitting upright, cool peripheries, neck veins distended to the angle of the jaw
exam.jvp: Markedly raised with sharp x descent and blunted y descent, rises further on inspiration
exam.other: Liver tender and palpable 3 cm below the costal margin, lungs clear, no focal neurology
exam.precordium: Quiet precordium, apex beat impalpable, dull percussion note over the cardiac area
exam.pulse: Rapid 120, thready, pulsus paradoxus above 12 mmHg on slow cuff deflation

history.a: Two weeks of fever with evening rise, dry cough, weight loss of 5 kg, then sudden worsening breathlessness for two days
history.q: What brings you to hospital today

history.a: Yes, sharp central pain eased by sitting forward, now replaced by pressure and breathlessness
history.q: Any chest pain, and what eases it

history.a: Two pillows for a month, now cannot lie flat at all
history.q: Breathlessness lying flat or at night

history.a: No wheeze, no sputum with blood
history.q: Any wheeze or blood in sputum

history.a: On antitubercular treatment for two months from the district centre, admits missing doses last fortnight
Marginal farmer, beedi smoker for 15 years, no alcohol
Wife treated for lymph node tuberculosis last year
history.q: tuberculosis in the family or household

keyPoints: Treat as an emergency and arrange urgent pericardiocentesis under echo guidance, per the ESC pericardial disease guideline
Give oxygen, secure large bore access, and avoid diuretics or vasodilators that lower preload before drainage
Send pericardial fluid for adenosine deaminase, microscopy, culture and molecular testing for tuberculosis
Restart and supervise antitubercular treatment with adherence counselling through the district centre
Monitor for constriction during follow up, as tuberculous pericarditis heals with fibrosis
management.model: Urgent echo guided pericardiocentesis with fluid testing for tuberculosis, preload preservation, and supervised antitubercular treatment

accept: right atrial and right ventricular diastolic collapse
dilated above 21 mm with below 50 percent collapse

sources: ESC guideline on pericardial disease, in own words
National tuberculosis elimination programme guidance on extrapulmonary disease, in own words
stem: A 38 year old farmer from Vidarbha, on antitubercular treatment that he stopped taking, presents with two days of rapidly worsening breathlessness, distended neck veins and a thready rapid pulse. The heart sounds are muffled with a rub, and pulsus paradoxus is present.
teaching: Tamponade after tuberculous pericarditis is the Indian emergency to recognise, and hypotension with a raised JVP plus muffled sounds is Beck triad in practice
Pulsus paradoxus above 10 mmHg plus chamber collapse on echo seals the diagnosis
A subxiphoid POCUS view is the fastest route to the diagnosis at the bedside
Drainage first, then prove tuberculosis in the fluid and restart supervised treatment
title: Cardiac tamponade after tuberculous pericarditis
